title: Daily sales summary to the owner
summary: Every evening, add up today's sales from your sales sheet and text the total to the owner.
description: Every day at the time you choose, reads your sales sheet (columns: date as YYYY-MM-DD, item, amount), adds up today's sales and how many there were, and sends the owner a short SMS with the total. The owner's phone number is the tenant variable owner_phone, so it never sits in the workflow.

variables.name: owner_phone
variables.why: The owner's phone number in international format without +, e.g. 2348012345678.

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.title: Sales spreadsheet
params.description: The spreadsheet's id, from its link.

params.name: sheet_range
params.title: Sheet and columns
params.description: Where the sales are, with a header row of date, item and amount.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the summary is sent, Lagos time.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

params.name: sheets_connection
params.title: Google Sheets connection
params.description: The name of your Google Sheets connection.

definition.name: Daily sales summary to the owner

input.sms: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ' sales today: ' + string(has(steps.totals.output.count) ? steps.totals.output.count : 0) + ' sale(s), NGN ' + string(has(steps.totals.output.total) ? steps.totals.output.total : 0)
